title: Shared definitions for every edge record
description: Referenced by the per-kind edge schemas and never used to validate a record directly. The per-kind schemas narrow the type and forbid anything they have not evaluated.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest, lowercase hex, exactly 64 characters. SHA-256 is fixed for the whole graph, so the digest needs no algorithm beside it (ADR-0005).

baseEdge.description: The fields every edge record carries, whatever its kind.

id.description: An absolute IRI minted at serialization time. Opaque: its parts are never split back out, because a part may itself contain the separator (ADR-0007).

type.description: The edge kind, prefixed. Narrowed to a constant per kind.

seg:from.description: An absolute IRI minted at serialization time. Opaque: its parts are never split back out, because a part may itself contain the separator (ADR-0007).

seg:to.description: An absolute IRI minted at serialization time. Opaque: its parts are never split back out, because a part may itself contain the separator (ADR-0007).

seg:linkState.description: The state the edge was last left in. Read from the record rather than recomputed: what was affirmed is a fact about the past, and comparing it against today is drift detection.

seg:edgeHash.description: The hash the edge was affirmed against, present exactly when there was an affirmation to record one.

then.description: A pending edge was never affirmed, so it has no hash it was affirmed against; a placeholder would be indistinguishable from a real hash that mismatches.
An active edge claims both endpoints are unchanged since it was affirmed, which is only checkable against the hash it was affirmed with.
